name: Norman Mineta Bay Area Summer Academy (MTC)
org: Metropolitan Transportation Commission (with ABAG, BCDC and the Bay Area Air District)
city: Bay Area (virtual sessions, final session in San Francisco)
what_you_do: A summer program introducing high school students to regional problems like transportation planning, housing, environmental justice (how pollution and development affect different communities) and air quality. You hear talks from experts at partner agencies.
who_can_apply: Bay Area residents who attend a local high school, are at least 15 and have finished 9th grade before it starts. Parent or guardian permission is needed under 18. GPA is not considered.
pay_detail: Stipend paid after completion; amount not stated
duration: 2026: virtual Thursday evening sessions in July plus a final in-person session at Bay Area Metro Center, San Francisco (July 31, 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 program is over. The 2026 call was announced March 24, 2026; exact open and close dates are not on the page. 2027 not posted.
how_to_apply: Contact Academy@BayAreaMetro.Gov or 415-778-5207. The page does not detail the application steps.
notes: MTC's older 'High School Internship Program' pages date to 2018. The high school program MTC lists now is this Academy. It is mostly virtual evening sessions. It is not a job placement.
